description: This file implements the 'col2im' operation optimized for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It defines functions to perform the col2im operation, including setup, parameter handling, and dispatching GPU compute kernels, primarily for converting columnar data back into images with hardware acceleration.

methods.name: col2im_out_mps_template
methods.description: Performs the col2im operation tailored for MPS, setting up GPU dispatch parameters and invoking the Metal shader for computation.

methods.name: col2im_out_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls the template to perform col2im and writes the output to the provided tensor.

methods.name: col2im_mps
methods.description: Creates an output tensor and performs the col2im operation optimized for MPS backend.
